dreamteamer.title: Meetings
dreamteamer.description: Your meetings as records — written by hand, by `/create-meeting` or by the calendar sync in `@dreamteamer/connectors-google-workspace` — with attendees as `contacts`, the company as `companies` and your people in the room as `users` (`ours`). Files a call's screenshots beside it (`/fetch-meeting-screenshots`) and stamps each attendee's contact with their latest meeting.
